# netcup_server_iso_images (Data Source)

The ISO images a netcup server can attach (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_iso_images" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `iso_images` (Attributes List) ISO images of the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--iso_images))

<a id="nestedatt--iso_images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `iso_images`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture of the image.
- `description` (String) Description of the image.
- `filename` (String) File name of the image.
- `id` (Number) Id of the image.
- `name` (String) Name of the image.
